title: Sparkly cookie
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Sparkles around the cookie -->
  <g fill="#FFE44D">
    <!-- top left sparkle -->
    <polygon points="18,20 20,26 26,28 20,30 18,36 16,30 10,28 16,26" />
    <!-- top right sparkle -->
    <polygon points="82,18 84,24 90,26 84,28 82,34 80,28 74,26 80,24" />
    <!-- bottom left sparkle -->
    <polygon points="15,72 17,78 23,80 17,82 15,88 13,82 7,80 13,78" />
    <!-- bottom right sparkle -->
    <polygon points="85,70 87,76 93,78 87,80 85,86 83,80 77,78 83,76" />
    <!-- left sparkle -->
    <polygon points="8,48 10,52 14,54 10,56 8,60 6,56 2,54 6,52" />
    <!-- right sparkle -->
    <polygon points="92,46 94,50 98,52 94,54 92,58 90,54 86,52 90,50" />
  </g>

  <!-- Cookie shadow / edge -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="52" r="30" fill="#C67A2E" />

  <!-- Cookie body -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="29" fill="#E8A84C" />
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="26" fill="#F0BC6A" />

  <!-- Slightly lighter top highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="46" cy="42" rx="14" ry="10" fill="#F5D08E" opacity="0.6" />

  <!-- Chocolate chips -->
  <g fill="#6B3A1F">
    <ellipse cx="38" cy="40" rx="4" ry="3.5" transform="rotate(-15 38 40)" />
    <ellipse cx="56" cy="36" rx="3.5" ry="3" transform="rotate(10 56 36)" />
    <ellipse cx="64" cy="48" rx="4" ry="3.5" transform="rotate(-20 64 48)" />
    <ellipse cx="42" cy="58" rx="4.5" ry="3.5" transform="rotate(15 42 58)" />
    <ellipse cx="58" cy="60" rx="3.5" ry="3" transform="rotate(-10 58 60)" />
    <ellipse cx="36" cy="50" rx="3" ry="2.5" transform="rotate(25 36 50)" />
    <ellipse cx="50" cy="48" rx="3.5" ry="3" transform="rotate(-5 50 48)" />
  </g>

  <!-- Cute face on cookie -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="47" rx="2.5" ry="3" fill="#5A2E0E" />
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="47" rx="2.5" ry="3" fill="#5A2E0E" />
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="46" r="0.9" fill="#FFF8E0" />
  <circle cx="59" cy="46" r="0.9" fill="#FFF8E0" />
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M44 55 Q50 61 56 55" stroke="#5A2E0E" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round" />
  <!-- Blush -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="53" rx="3.5" ry="2" fill="#E8837A" opacity="0.7" />
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="53" rx="3.5" ry="2" fill="#E8837A" opacity="0.7" />
</svg>
